parts.label: (d)
parts.text:
At $25^\circ\text{C}$ the enthalpy change of solution of compound $\mathbf{Z}$ is $+26\text{ kJ mol}^{-1}$. The entropy change of solution of $\mathbf{Z}$ at the same temperature is $+52\text{ J K}^{-1}\text{ mol}^{-1}$.

Calculate the value of the Gibbs free energy change, $\Delta G$, for the solution of $\mathbf{Z}$ at $25^\circ\text{C}$.

parts.label: (e)(i)
parts.text: Use your answer to **(d)** to predict whether or not $\mathbf{Z}$ is soluble in water at $25^\circ\text{C}$. Explain your answer.

parts.label: (e)(ii)
parts.text: Predict whether $\mathbf{Z}$ becomes more or less soluble as the water is heated from $25^\circ\text{C}$ to $95^\circ\text{C}$. Explain your answer.
